name: Mr. Mustard
greeting: The structure is inside you, my guy.

topics.label: Try to argue with him
topics.line: I think you're wrong about the play.
topics.goodText: "I'm not gonna fight you on this. You're right. Doesn't change anything though."

topics.label: Ask for performance coaching
topics.goodText: "The structure is inside you, my guy." Somehow, this helps.

topics.label: Ask what he did before teaching
topics.line: What did you do before teaching?
topics.goodText: "Cruise ship magician. Then a shipwreck. Then this." Wholesome and undramatic.

topics.label: Vent about stress
topics.line: Everything is a lot right now.
topics.goodText: He listens. Genuinely good, grounding advice.

gifts.likeText: "Track seven is just breathing. That's art."
